verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud has an official MCP server and CLI (salesforcecli/mcp, `sf data query`) plus documented APIs. Agents can therefore query CRM records such as accounts, opportunities, and automatically synced emails and events. Agentforce Builder also connects agents to Salesforce data, Flows, and Apex. Missing for 10: documentation of an account-brief or meeting-prep workflow, evidence of which objects the MCP server's tools expose (especially email and activity history), and independent hands-on corroboration.
